The company said that growth was its highest in five years. It reported a domestic comparable sales increase of 6.2% and international comparable sales growth of 4.9%. Shares of Best Buy climbed 6% following the report . Best Buy also raised its guidance for the rest of the year. It's now expecting full-year revenue of between $43 billion and $43.3 billion compared with a previous expectation of between $42.3 billion and $42.8 billion. It's expecting comparable sales to be up 3.4% to 4% compared with prior guidance of between 1.9% and 3%. The earnings report is the company's first since Jason Bonfig took over as CEO from Corie Barry at the beginning of the month. "Disciplined execution, a compelling product cycle and continued market share gains helped drive broad-based topline momentum across nearly all product categories, our services offerings, and both our digital and store channels," Bonfig said in a statement about the most recent quarter. Here's how the company performed in the period ended Oct. 31 compared with what Wall Street was expecting, based on a survey of analysts by LSEG: Earnings per share: $1.62 adjusted vs. $1.49 expected Revenue: $10.24 billion vs. $9.90 billion expected Best Buy reported net income of $353 million, or $1.66 per share, compared with $140 million, or 66 cents per share, the year prior. Adjusting for one-time items, including restructuring charges, Best Buy posted adjusted earnings of $1.62 per share. Revenue rose to $10.24 billion from $9.67 billion in the year-ago period. Best Buy reported domestic revenue of $9.42 billion and international revenue of $820 million. Tuesday's earnings are the latest in a series of strong reports from the retailer, which has been instituting a turnaround strategy to return to growth after getting hit by declining foot traffic, lower consumer sentiment, tariffs and memory costs . Shares of Best Buy are up nearly 45% this year. Bonfig told CNBC last quarter that the launch of " Grand Theft Auto VI " in the current quarter is expected to drive sales in the gaming category, which has been seeing gains over the past year. Last month, Best Buy launched a new gaming experience for customers featuring gaming content, technology and special offers, among other features.
